text: Austria here. I propose we stay out of each other's way: I won't move on VEN or TYR-south, and I'd like the same from you. Any plan for the Balkans or Adriatic you want to coordinate on?
Austria here. I'm happy to keep the peace in the Balkans. I'm putting my focus on SER and GAL. Let's keep each other informed if Russia moves south.

Hi France, England here. How about we keep the English Channel empty? I won't send anything into ENG if you don't. Then you're free to go south for Iberia and I go north. I'm open to working together against Germany later.

Hi Germany, England here. I'm aiming for Norway this year. Denmark and Holland are yours, I won't contest them. Would you agree to a North Sea / Helgoland understanding: I don't move to HEL and you stay out of NTH? Also, what is France telling you?

Hi Russia, England here. I'm going for Norway, and I'd like to leave your north alone. If your STP fleet goes to Bothnia/Sweden, that's fine with me. Shall we keep Barents empty and talk about Germany later?

France here. I'm moving my fleet out of the Channel toward MAO and keeping my army out of Belgium/Picardy for now. Proposal: we both stay out of each other's home centers this year and I won't contest the North Sea or Channel. Let me know if you agree.

France here. I'm taking Spain this spring and moving toward Burgundy, not toward Piedmont or Tunis. If you keep to the Adriatic and Tunis, I see no reason for us to fight. Happy to talk about a non-aggression pact.

Germany here. I'm not interested in an early war with anyone. My plan is to take Denmark, Holland and Belgium neutrally and keep my border with France and Russia quiet. Happy to agree to no-moves into each other's home centers this year. Tell me your plans, especially France and Russia.

Italy here. I propose a peaceful opening for everyone. I will not move against anyone in the north this year. My focus is the Mediterranean: Tunis, Greece and the Adriatic. Austria, I'm happy to keep our border quiet while you deal with Russia and the Balkans. France, I'd welcome a shared approach to Spain and Tunis. Let's all avoid early wars that only help Russia or Turkey grow.

Russia here. I have no quarrel with you in the Black Sea. I'm watching Austria and would prefer we both keep our fleets out of each other's home waters this year. Would you agree to no moves into SEV or ARM from your side, and I'll do the same for ANK and CON? Open to your ideas.
Russia proposes an open, peaceful opening. Anyone willing to share intel on early moves, reply and we can coordinate. No one benefits from an early bloodbath.

Turkey here. I'm opening toward Bulgaria and the Black Sea, and I have no quarrel with anyone for now. I'd like to keep the Black Sea and Balkans peaceful and talk to Russia and Austria about Rumania and Serbia. Happy to share intel. Who wants to coordinate against whichever power grows fastest?

Austria here. I'd like to keep Galicia and the north-south border calm this year. I won't move into WAR or UKR. Can you confirm you won't go into GAL or RUM? If you agree, I'll keep my units off your home centers.
Austria here. I'm not planning an early war. My focus is Serbia and Galicia, and I'll keep TRI, VIE and BUD defended. Happy to share intel on Russia and France as the year goes on.

Agreed, France: no moves into each other's home centers, and ENG stays empty. Note Germany says publicly he wants Denmark, Holland AND Belgium. That's a lot of growth for one power. I'd rather Belgium didn't go to him. Want to keep an eye on him together?

Thanks Germany. No moves into each other's home centers this year works for me. Denmark and Holland are fine. Belgium is sensitive for me and France, so let's talk about it later rather than now. Do you agree to me staying out of HEL and you staying out of NTH?
Agreed on a peaceful opening, Russia. I'm heading to Norway. If you take Sweden I won't contest it. Let's keep Barents empty and share what Germany tells us.
France: Agreed. I'm moving my fleet out of the Channel to MAO and I won't enter ENG, NTH or your home centers. I'll go south and west. Let's keep the North Sea and Channel clear of each other.

France: Fine by me on no-moves into each other's homes this year. I'm taking Spain and Portugal and I'm not moving into Belgium or Holland. My army in Burgundy is defensive. I'd like your word that Munich and Burgundy stay quiet too.

France: Confirmed. I'm taking Spain this spring, not Piedmont or Tunis. If you keep to the Adriatic, Tunis and Greece, we have no reason to fight. Let's coordinate so Spain doesn't become a fight between us.

Germany here. Agreed on the North Sea: I won't move into NTH and I'll keep KIE out of HEL this spring. Please keep your fleets out of HEL and HOL too. France hasn't told me its plans yet. Good luck with Norway.

Germany: I'm opening defensively. No early attacks on anyone. I'm taking Denmark and Holland neutrally and keeping my home centers covered. Russia and France, please confirm you're not planning to strike Germany this year, and I'll do the same.

Italy here. Agreed: no moves on each other this year. I'll keep VEN/TRI quiet. I'm watching Turkey in the Balkans; if you want to coordinate on Greece/Serbia vs Turkey later, let's talk. Tell me if you plan Trieste-Albania.
Italy here. Fine with a non-aggression pact: I stay out of Piedmont-Marseilles and you stay out of Tunis and Rome/Venice. I'll take Tunis and Greece-side Adriatic. Let's keep it that way.

Italy: I support a peaceful 1901 for all. I won't attack anyone in the north. I'll move toward Tunis and the Adriatic only. Turkey, I'd like to see you not push into Greece aggressively, as I plan to claim it.
Russia here. Agreed: I'll keep STP out of Norway and leave Barents empty. My fleet may go to Bothnia or Finland, not toward you. Good luck on Norway.

Russia here. Fine by me to keep the west quiet. I'm watching Austria in the south and want no fight with you. Could you confirm you won't move on Warsaw, Prussia or Silesia this year? I'll return the same.
Russia again. Black Sea non-aggression still stands from my side: no moves into ANK or CON. If you agree, I'll leave Rumania alone this spring and keep Sevastopol defended.

Turkey to Russia: Agreed, no moves into SEV or ARM from me this year. I'll take Bulgaria and hold the Black Sea. Please don't move F SEV into BLA or ANK-side waters. Rumania is open; let's each keep our hands off the other's home centers.

Turkey to Austria: Good to hear. I'm going for Bulgaria and possibly Rumania, so Serbia and Greece are yours to contest with Italy. Let's keep our border quiet this year and share any Russian moves toward Rumania.

Turkey: Thanks all. I'm focused on Bulgaria and the Black Sea, with no attacks planned this year. Agreed in principle to a quiet 1901 across the board. Let's watch for whichever power breaks the peace first.

Austria here. Still waiting on your answer: will you stay out of GAL and RUM this year? I'm not moving into WAR or UKR, and I'm putting my energy into SER. Confirming would let us both focus south and west.
Deal, Germany: I stay out of HEL and HOL this spring, and you stay out of NTH. My fleets are heading north toward Norway. Let's keep talking each phase.
Good, France, we're agreed. Please tell me what Germany says to you about Belgium and Burgundy. If he gets greedy, we can handle him together in 1902.
Thanks Russia, that works for me. Let's keep sharing what we hear, especially from Germany.

France: Agreed on keeping ENG and the Channel clear. On Germany: I'm happy to watch him with you. If Germany moves into Belgium or Holland in a way that threatens either of us, let's coordinate our response in the fall.

France: Confirmed, I'm not planning to strike Germany in 1901. I'm going west into Spain and Portugal. Please keep Munich and Burgundy quiet on your side too, and let's both stay clear of each other's home centers.
France: Agreed. I stay out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis. You keep out of Marseilles and Spain. Let's keep the Mediterranean split clean.

Germany: I confirm no German move into Burgundy, Munich-to-Burgundy or Belgium this year. Please keep Burgundy and Picardy out of Ruhr and Munich too. Spain and Portugal are yours, I won't contest them.
Germany: I confirm I won't move on Warsaw, Prussia or Silesia in 1901. Please do the same toward Berlin and Silesia. If Austria pushes on Galicia, I'm open to coordinating.
Germany: Confirmed, my fleet stays out of NTH and KIE stays out of HEL. Please keep your fleets out of HOL and HEL as well.

Italy, round 3: Still peaceful from my side. I'm moving on Tunis and the Ionian/Adriatic this year and will not touch Austria, France or Germany in the north. If anyone plans to strike Italy's home centers (NAP, ROM, VEN), tell me now so we can avoid misreads.
Russia here. Agreed for 1901: I won't move into GAL or RUM this spring, provided Austria keeps its units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV. Please confirm and we'll both hold.
Russia: I confirm no moves into WAR, PRU or SIL from me this year. Please keep BER and KIE-side moves away from my centers too.
Russia: Good. Black Sea stays quiet from both of us. I'll keep SEV defensive and won't enter RUM this spring.
Turkey to Russia: Confirmed. No moves into ANK, CON, SEV or ARM from me in 1901. I'll take Bulgaria and leave Rumania alone this spring. If you move on Rumania, let me know first.
Turkey: Still aiming for a quiet 1901. My moves are Bulgaria and the Black Sea only. I'm watching for anyone who breaks the peace early.
Austria here. I confirm: no Austrian units into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV this year. I'm taking the Balkans instead. Please confirm you're staying out of GAL and RUM, so we can both hold.
Sounds good, France. ENG stays clear and we'll coordinate in the fall if Germany pushes into Belgium. Good luck in Iberia.
Confirmed, Germany. No HEL and no HOL from me this spring. Talk again in the fall.

France: My army is moving through Burgundy this spring, but only toward Spain's direction and not against Munich, Ruhr or Belgium. I'll keep my word on no moves into your home centers. Please keep Munich and Ruhr clear of Burgundy.
France: Still holding the Channel and North Sea agreement. Germany's Belgium/Holland plans are on my watch list too. If he moves on Belgium in Fall, I'm open to coordinating a response with you.

Germany, round 4: Still defensive. I'm moving KIE to Denmark and keeping Berlin and Munich at home. I won't attack France, Russia or England this year, and I expect the same. If anyone plans a move on my home centers (BER, KIE, MUN), tell me now.

Italy, round 4: Still peaceful. Confirming my plan: Tunis (via Naples/Rome fleets) and Greece later, with no moves into Austria, France, Germany or Russia this year. Turkey, please keep your fleets out of the Ionian and Aegean-west this spring. Austria, if you do go for Serbia, let's agree that Greece stays mine.
Russia here. Confirmed for 1901: I won't move into GAL or RUM this spring. In return, please keep Austrian units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV. If you hold to that, we can both focus elsewhere.
Russia: Still peaceful from my side. I'm holding my home centers and not attacking anyone this year. Let's keep sharing any moves we hear about.
Austria here. Thanks for confirming. Austria holds to it: no Austrian units into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV in 1901. Let's both keep GAL and RUM quiet this year and talk again in Fall.
Austria here. Agreed on a quiet 1901. Greece is yours to claim, Italy, and I'm focused on Serbia. Turkey, Bulgaria and Rumania are yours to contest with Russia. Let's share any movement we see.
England: Confirmed. Norway for me, Sweden is yours if you want it, and Barents stays empty. Let's compare notes on Germany after the spring.

Germany, round 5: Final word for 1901. No German moves into NTH, HEL, HOL, BUR, BEL, PIC, WAR, PRU or SIL. KIE goes to Denmark, which is neutral. Anyone who attacks my home centers (BER, KIE, MUN) will face a united Germany. Let's keep 1901 quiet and talk again in Fall.

Italy, round 5: Final word before orders. I'm holding NAP, ROM and VEN this spring and moving toward Tunis and the Adriatic/Ionian. I will not move into Austria, France, Germany, Russia or Turkey this year. Anyone who attacks my home centers will find me defending them, so please stay out of NAP, ROM and VEN.
Russia here. Confirming again for 1901: I will not move into GAL or RUM this spring. Please keep Austrian units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV. Balkans for you is fine by me.

Russia, round 5: No moves from me on anyone this spring. I'm holding STP, SEV, MOS and WAR and keeping the agreements with England, Germany and Turkey. Any power that breaks the peace should expect us to coordinate against it.

Turkey, round 5: Final confirmation of my 1901 plan. I'm moving into Bulgaria only, with no moves into Austria, Italy, Germany, France, Russia or England home centers. I'll keep my fleets out of the Ionian and Aegean-west, as Italy asked. Turkey will support a quiet 1901 across the board.
Turkey to Russia: Confirmed, no Turkish moves into SEV, ARM, ANK or CON, and I'm leaving Rumania alone this spring. Please keep your side of the Black Sea quiet too.
Austria here. Fall 1901: I'm holding Serbia and my home centers. Still no Austrian moves into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm you'll stay out of GAL and RUM this fall.
Austria here. I hold Serbia, and I'm not moving toward Greece or Albania this fall. Let's keep Trieste and Venice quiet on both sides.

England: Thanks for keeping ENG clear. My idea for fall: I take Norway and Belgium, you take Spain and Portugal, and Germany only gets Denmark (he can't reach Holland this turn). That keeps him small. Can your army in BUR stay out of Belgium? Burgundy-Munich pressure on him would help us both later.
England: Taking Norway this fall as agreed. Sweden is yours. Germany has a fleet in Denmark that could go for Sweden, so watch it. What are you hearing from him?
England: Spring went as we agreed, thanks. I'm going for Norway this fall. Same arrangement as before? I stay out of HEL and you stay out of NTH.

France: Spain is ours. This Fall I plan to take Portugal with the army in Spain and fleet MAO. I'm also watching Belgium. If Germany moves into BEL or HOL, I'm open to a joint response with you. Are you still keeping the Channel clear?
France: Burgundy stays put this Fall. I'm not moving toward Munich, Ruhr or Belgium. Please keep your units out of Burgundy and Belgium too, and tell me if you plan otherwise.
France: I'm staying out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis as agreed. I hold Spain and will take Portugal this Fall. Please keep your fleets out of MAO and Spain.

Germany: Your army moved into Burgundy, which is next to Munich. I kept my word and didn't move there. Please confirm in writing that Burgundy stays off Munich, Ruhr and Belgium this Fall, and I'll keep Munich and Berlin at home.
Germany: Your fleets are now at NTH and NWG. I'm in DEN, which is neutral, and I'm not moving into NTH or HEL. Please keep your North Sea fleet out of DEN and HEL this Fall, and I'll do the same.
Germany, Fall 1901: I'm holding BER and MUN and my fleet is in Denmark. I want a quiet Fall and no one moving on my home centers. Who has plans for Belgium, Holland or Denmark? Let's share them now.

Italy here. Our split holds: I take Tunis this fall with my fleet from TYS. Please keep F MAO and your army out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis, and I'll stay out of Spain and Marseilles. Let me know if you plan anything into WES or TYS.

Italy here. You have SER now, so I'm assuming Greece/Albania is not yours to take this fall. I'm keeping VEN and TRI untouched. Let me know if you plan to move on Trieste or Venice; I'd like that to stay off the table.
Italy, Fall 1901 round 1: Still peaceful. I'm moving to Tunis and holding Rome and Venice. No moves into any power's home centers planned. Turkey, please stay out of Greece and the Ionian this fall.

Russia to Turkey: Your F ANK went to BLA, next to SEV, and A CON is at BUL. Our deal was no moves into SEV or ARM. Please confirm F BLA will not move into SEV or ARM this fall. I'm holding SEV and will not enter RUM or BUL.
Russia to Austria: You took SER as agreed and kept out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV. I'm holding my units this fall too. Please confirm you won't move into GAL or WAR while we keep the peace.
Russia: Fall 1901 is open. I'm holding my home centers and expect everyone to honor the spring agreements. Any unit that moves on a home center will be seen as the aggressor.

Turkey, Fall 1901 opening: I now hold Bulgaria with A BUL and A CON, and F BLA holds the Black Sea. SMY is empty, so my home centers are still mine. I'm not planning to attack anyone this Fall. I'm watching Rumania and Serbia closely, and I'd like to hear everyone's Fall plans before we move.

Turkey to Russia: Thanks for keeping the Black Sea quiet. Bulgaria is now mine. I expect you to hold SEV and not move into RUM or BUL this Fall, and I'll do the same for SEV and ARM. If you want Rumania, tell me first and we can split it.

Turkey: Serbia and Greece are both open. I'm not moving on either this Fall. Austria, what are your Fall orders for SER? Italy, I'm staying out of Greece for now, so you can take it without worrying about me.

Austria here. Confirmed: no Austrian moves into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. I have no current plan to move into GAL this fall, and I'd like your word that you stay out of GAL and RUM. Let's both hold this fall.
Austria here. I'm holding SER this fall and not moving on GRE, ALB, BUL or RUM. Turkey, I'm glad you're staying out of SER. Italy, I'm keeping TRI and VEN untouched.

England: Yes, the Channel stays clear, I promise. Portugal is yours and good luck. Germany can't reach Belgium or Holland this fall, so the only clash risk is between us. I'd like Belgium. Could A BUR hold or go to Munich/Gascony instead? In return I'll back you against Germany in 1902 and stay out of ENG, MAO and Brest.
England: Agreed. My fleets stay out of DEN and HEL this fall. I'm taking Norway. You keep out of NTH and we're fine.

France: Confirmed. A BUR stays off Munich, Ruhr and Belgium this Fall. It holds or moves only toward Gascony/Marseilles area. I'm taking Portugal, not contesting Germany. Please keep your units out of Burgundy and Picardy too.

France: Agreed. I'm taking Portugal this Fall and keeping ENG clear. A BUR stays out of Belgium. Fine with you taking Norway and Belgium. If Germany pushes into Holland or Belgium later, we coordinate.
France: Agreed. I stay out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis. I'm moving only to Portugal this Fall, with no fleets into WES or TYS. Please keep your fleets out of MAO and Spain.
Germany, round 2: I'm holding Munich and Berlin this Fall and won't move into Burgundy, Ruhr or Belgium. Please keep A BUR off MUN and RUH. If you move toward Belgium, tell me first.
Germany, round 2: Same arrangement works. I stay out of NTH and HEL. Please keep your fleets out of DEN and HEL this Fall. I'm not going to contest Norway.
Germany, round 2: Holding BER and MUN, fleet in DEN. No German moves into any power's home centers this Fall. Russia, Austria, Turkey: if your fall plans touch Germany or Denmark, tell me now.

Italy here. Confirmed: I move F TYS to Tunis this fall and keep my armies in Rome and Venice. You hold Spain and Portugal, I stay out of both. Please keep F MAO and your army out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis. Tell me if that changes.
Italy here. Thanks for staying out of Greece and the Ionian. I'm holding my home centers and going for Tunis. Let's keep the Aegean and Ionian quiet while we both focus elsewhere.

Italy, Fall 1901 round 2: Quiet from my side. I'm taking Tunis this fall and holding NAP (empty, still mine), ROM and VEN. No moves on any home center planned. Austria, Germany, Russia: share any plans that touch the Balkans or the north.

Russia to Turkey: F BLA sits next to SEV and A CON moved to BUL, so I need a clear answer. Will F BLA move into SEV or ARM this fall? If not, I'll keep SEV defensive and make no moves into RUM or BUL. Confirm and I'll stay put.
Russia to Austria: I'm holding this fall. I won't move into GAL or RUM while Austria keeps out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV. Please confirm again so we both stay calm.
Russia, Fall 1901: I'm holding all home centers. Anyone planning a move into a home center should tell us first so we can avoid misreads.

Turkey to Russia: Confirmed. F BLA will not move into SEV or ARM this Fall, and I won't enter RUM or BUL with my own units. A BUL is my unit in Bulgaria and I'm holding it. If you want Rumania, tell me first and we can split it.

Turkey, Fall 1901 round 2: I'm holding A BUL, A CON and F BLA this Fall with no attacks planned. I'm not moving on Serbia, Greece, Rumania or any home center. Russia, Austria, Italy: if you have concrete Fall moves, tell me now so we avoid misreads.

Austria here, Fall 1901 round 3. I'm holding SER and my home centers this fall. I have no moves into GAL, RUM, WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm you won't move into GAL or RUM, and we can both stay calm.
Austria here. I'm holding SER this fall with no moves toward GRE, ALB, BUL or RUM. I'm keeping TRI and VEN untouched. If either of you has concrete plans that touch the Balkans, tell me now.

England: Thanks France, deal confirmed. Norway and Belgium for me, Spain and Portugal for you, ENG stays clear. In 1902 let's plan a joint move on Germany. Your army in Burgundy plus my fleets could squeeze Munich, Kiel and Holland.
England: Confirmed. No DEN or HEL from me this fall. Good luck.
France: Confirmed again. A BUR will not move to Munich, Ruhr or Belgium this Fall. I'm only taking Portugal. Please keep your units out of Burgundy and Picardy, and tell me if your plans change.
France: Agreed. I'm taking Portugal, staying out of ENG, NTH and your home centers, and A BUR stays out of Belgium. Let's coordinate on Germany in 1902 if he pushes into Holland or Belgium.
France: Confirmed. I stay out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis, with no fleets into WES or TYS. Please keep your fleets out of MAO and Spain.

Germany, round 3: Burgundy is one step from Munich, and I need a clear answer. Will A BUR move to MUN, RUH or BEL in Fall 1901 or Spring 1902? If not, I'll keep Munich and Berlin defended and we stay at peace.
Germany, round 3: Austria and France are both active near my borders. If either attacks Berlin, Munich or Silesia, I'd like us to coordinate. Are you still holding Warsaw and Moscow this Fall?

Italy, round 3: Still on the same split. F TYS goes to Tunis this fall. Please keep F MAO and your army out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis, and I'll stay out of Spain and Portugal. Shout now if that changes.

Italy, Fall 1901 round 3: No moves planned into any home center. I'm taking Tunis this fall and holding ROM and VEN. Austria, Turkey, Russia, Germany: if your fall plans touch Italy, Greece or Tunis, tell me now.
Russia to Turkey: Thanks for confirming F BLA stays out of SEV and ARM. I'm holding SEV and won't enter RUM or BUL. If your fleet changes plans, tell me first so we avoid a misread.
Russia to Austria: Confirmed, I'm holding this fall and will not move into GAL or RUM. Please keep Austrian units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV as agreed.
Russia, Fall 1901 round 3: Still holding all home centers, no attacks planned. Anyone with a concrete move touching a home center, please say so now.

Turkey to Russia: Confirmed again. F BLA will not move into SEV or ARM this Fall, and no Turkish unit enters RUM or BUL except A BUL holding. If you want Rumania, tell me before you move and we can discuss a split.

Turkey, Fall 1901 round 3: Still holding A BUL, A CON and F BLA with no attacks planned. No Turkish moves on Serbia, Greece, Rumania or any home center this Fall. If anyone plans a move that touches Turkish centers (ANK, CON, SMY) or Bulgaria, tell me now.
Austria, Fall 1901 round 4: I'm holding SER and my home centers. Still no Austrian moves into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm once more that you stay out of GAL and RUM this fall.
Austria, Fall 1901 round 4: Holding SER, BUD, TRI, VIE with no attacks planned. No moves into any home center from me. Anyone with a concrete plan touching the Balkans, tell me now.
England: Confirmed, all agreed. Good luck in Portugal. Let's talk 1902 plans against Germany in the winter.
England: Norway for me this fall, as agreed. Are you taking Sweden? Germany's fleet in Denmark could go for it. If he moves there, we should work together against him in 1902.

France: Clear answer: A BUR will NOT move to Munich, Ruhr or Belgium in Fall 1901. My only Fall move is SPA-POR. I'm not planning anything against Germany this year. Please keep your units off Burgundy and Picardy, and I'll do the same.

France: Confirmed. Spain and Portugal are mine, ENG and NTH stay clear, and A BUR stays out of Belgium. I'm open to coordinating on Germany in 1902 if he pushes into Holland or Belgium, but no commitments beyond that yet.
Germany, round 4: Thanks for confirming A BUR stays off MUN, RUH and BEL. I'm holding BER and MUN this Fall. If your plans change, tell me before you move, not after.

Germany, round 4: Holding BER and MUN, fleet in DEN, no moves on any home center this Fall. Russia, Austria, Turkey: if your Fall orders touch Germany, DEN or Silesia, please tell me now so we avoid misreads.
Italy, round 4: Confirmed. F TYS goes to Tunis this fall. I stay out of Spain, Portugal, MAO and Marseilles. Please keep your army and fleet out of Piedmont, Rome, Venice and Tunis.

Russia to Turkey, round 4: Thanks for confirming F BLA stays out of SEV and ARM. I'm holding SEV and will not enter RUM or BUL. If you ever want to split Rumania, tell me first and we'll talk before anyone moves.
Russia to Austria, round 4: Confirmed again, I won't move into GAL or RUM this fall. Please keep Austrian units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV as agreed.
Russia to Germany, round 4: I'm holding WAR, MOS, SEV and STP this fall and have no plans against you. If Austria moves on Silesia or Berlin, I'm open to coordinating.

Austria here, Fall 1901 round 5. Austria is holding SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. No Austrian moves into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm you stay out of GAL and RUM this fall, and we can both hold into 1902.
England: Thanks France, understood. Our deal stands and I'll keep my side of it. Let's talk in the winter.
England: All agreed. Quiet fall between us. Let's talk again in the winter about 1902.
Germany, Fall 1901 round 5: Holding BER and MUN, fleet in DEN, no moves into any home center. I expect the same from everyone. Any change to that, tell me before orders are read.

Italy, Fall 1901 round 5: Final word before orders. I'm moving F TYS to Tunis and holding ROM and VEN. No moves into any home center from me, and no fleets into MAO, Spain, Portugal or Greece. Austria, Turkey, Russia, Germany: please say now if your Fall orders touch Italy, Tunis or the Ionian.
Russia, final word for Fall 1901: I'm holding WAR, MOS, SEV and STP and will not move into GAL or RUM. Please keep Austrian units out of WAR, UKR, MOS and SEV as agreed.
Russia, final word: F BLA stays out of SEV and ARM as you confirmed, and I won't enter RUM or BUL. If you want to discuss Rumania in 1902, tell me first.
Turkey, Fall 1901 round 5: Final word. Holding A BUL, A CON and F BLA this Fall. No Turkish moves on Serbia, Greece, Rumania or any home center. Turkey is not attacking anyone this year.

England: Thanks France, our deal worked well. For 1902 I suggest we move on Germany together. He's holding at home and has only Denmark. Holland is open: I could take it with support from Belgium while your Burgundy army presses Munich or Ruhr. I'll keep ENG clear and stay out of your area. What are you building?

England: Norway went fine, thanks for keeping your side. Sweden is still open. Germany's Denmark fleet is the main threat to it. Want to coordinate in 1902? Your STP fleet to Bothnia/Sweden and me pressing Denmark from NTH/SKA would keep him boxed in.
England: Quiet year between us, thanks. I took Belgium from the sea and you weren't contesting it. I'd like the peace in the north to continue. What are your plans for 1902?

France: Winter update. I'm building an army in Paris to hold the Burgundy line. Spain and Portugal are mine, Channel and North Sea stay clear. Let's coordinate on Germany for 1902 once Fall orders are read.
France: Winter update. I'm building in Paris, defensive only. A BUR stays off Munich, Ruhr and Belgium as agreed. Please keep your units off Burgundy and Picardy.

Germany, Winter 1901: Congratulations to England on Belgium and Norway. I'm building an army in Kiel for defense and will hold BER, MUN and DEN. I still expect no moves into my home centers. France and Russia, please confirm you're not planning anything against Munich or Berlin in 1902.

Italy, Winter 1901: Tunis is taken and I'm building an army in Naples to hold our home centers. No moves planned against anyone. Keep the Ionian and Greece quiet and I'll do the same. Share any plans that touch Italy.

Russia, Winter 1901: I have no builds (4 centers, 4 units) and am holding MOS, SEV, STP, WAR. Still no attacks from me. Austria, Germany, England: please confirm your 1902 plans, especially anything touching SWE, RUM or WAR.

Austria here, Winter 1901. I'm building an army in Budapest for defense. I still have no moves into WAR, UKR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm again that you'll stay out of GAL and RUM in 1902, so we can both focus elsewhere.

England: Good, an army in Paris makes sense. Concrete 1902 idea: in spring I move Belgium to Holland with fleet support, and you go Burgundy to Ruhr or Munich. That stops Germany from covering both. By fall we split his centers: Holland and Denmark for me, Munich for you, and Kiel/Berlin later. Channel stays clear as always. Deal?
England: Thanks Germany. I'm building at home and have no plans against Berlin, Kiel or Munich. Holland is still neutral. What are you aiming for in 1902? Sweden, or something to the south?

England: I have no plans on SWE, STP or anything Russian in 1902. If you take Sweden, good. Germany's Denmark fleet is the only threat to it. If he moves there, tell me and I'll press Denmark from the sea.

France: Thanks, England. I'm open to 1902 action against Germany, but I want to see Holland move first. I won't commit A BUR to Munich or Ruhr until we agree on who takes what. Spain/Portugal stay mine, and I'll keep ENG and NTH clear. Your Belgium army should hold for now.
